---
title: "fungal genera driving fungal vbetadiversity PCoA structure"
format: html
---
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Identify fungal genera driving RefSeq fungal PCoA structure
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(vegan)
})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"
data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

pcoa_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "pcoa_coordinates.tsv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "fungal_pcoa_drivers")
fig_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "fungal_pcoa_drivers")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# Settings
# -----------------------------

pseudocount <- 1e-6
top_n_labels <- 10

outcome_colours <- c(
  "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
  "sPTB 34–37" = "#9467bd",
  "sPTB <34" = "#ff7f0e"
)

# ============================================================
# 1. Read PCoA coordinates
# ============================================================

pcoa <- read.delim(
  pcoa_file,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Create delivery group used in plots
pcoa <- pcoa %>%
  mutate(
    birth_group = case_when(
      outcome == "TERM" ~ "TERM",
      outcome == "sPTB" & sPTB34 == "no" ~ "sPTB 34–37",
      outcome == "sPTB" & sPTB34 == "yes" ~ "sPTB <34",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    birth_group = factor(
      birth_group,
      levels = c("TERM", "sPTB 34–37", "sPTB <34")
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 2. Read fungal genus matrix
# Rows = samples
# Columns = fungal genera
# ============================================================

fungal_counts <- read.delim(
  fungal_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

fungal_counts[] <- lapply(fungal_counts, as.numeric)
fungal_counts <- as.matrix(fungal_counts)
fungal_counts[is.na(fungal_counts)] <- 0

# Clean matrix sample IDs by removing trailing _1
fungal_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(fungal_counts))
rownames(fungal_counts) <- fungal_ids_clean

# ============================================================
# 3. Match fungal matrix to PCoA coordinates
# ============================================================

common_ids <- intersect(pcoa$reads_ID, rownames(fungal_counts))

if (length(common_ids) == 0) {
  stop("No overlapping sample IDs between PCoA coordinates and fungal matrix.")
}

pcoa_matched <- pcoa %>%
  filter(reads_ID %in% common_ids) %>%
  arrange(match(reads_ID, common_ids))

fungal_matched <- fungal_counts[
  match(pcoa_matched$reads_ID, rownames(fungal_counts)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (!all(pcoa_matched$reads_ID == rownames(fungal_matched))) {
  stop("PCoA and fungal matrix sample order mismatch.")
}

message("Matched samples: ", nrow(fungal_matched))
message("Fungal genera: ", ncol(fungal_matched))

# ============================================================
# 4. Convert fungal counts to relative abundance
# ============================================================

row_totals <- rowSums(fungal_matched)

fungal_rel <- sweep(fungal_matched, 1, row_totals, "/")
fungal_rel[is.na(fungal_rel)] <- 0

# Log transform for axis-correlation analysis
fungal_log <- log10(fungal_rel + pseudocount)

# ============================================================
# 5. Correlate each genus with PCoA Axis 1 and Axis 2
# ============================================================

correlation_results <- lapply(colnames(fungal_log), function(genus) {
  
  x <- fungal_log[, genus]
  
  axis1_test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(x, pcoa_matched$Axis1, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )
  
  axis2_test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(x, pcoa_matched$Axis2, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )
  
  data.frame(
    genus = genus,
    axis1_rho = unname(axis1_test$estimate),
    axis1_p = axis1_test$p.value,
    axis2_rho = unname(axis2_test$estimate),
    axis2_p = axis2_test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    axis1_q = p.adjust(axis1_p, method = "BH"),
    axis2_q = p.adjust(axis2_p, method = "BH"),
    abs_axis1_rho = abs(axis1_rho),
    abs_axis2_rho = abs(axis2_rho)
  )

write.csv(
  correlation_results,
  file.path(out_dir, "fungal_genera_correlated_with_pcoa_axes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

top_axis1 <- correlation_results %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_axis1_rho)) %>%
  select(genus, axis1_rho, axis1_p, axis1_q) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

top_axis2 <- correlation_results %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_axis2_rho)) %>%
  select(genus, axis2_rho, axis2_p, axis2_q) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

write.csv(
  top_axis1,
  file.path(out_dir, "top_20_genera_driving_pcoa_axis1.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  top_axis2,
  file.path(out_dir, "top_20_genera_driving_pcoa_axis2.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 6. Run envfit
# This fits fungal genus vectors onto the PCoA ordination
# ============================================================

ordination <- pcoa_matched %>%
  select(Axis1, Axis2)

envfit_result <- envfit(
  ordination,
  fungal_rel,
  permutations = 999
)

envfit_vectors <- as.data.frame(scores(envfit_result, display = "vectors"))
envfit_vectors$genus <- rownames(envfit_vectors)
envfit_vectors$r2 <- envfit_result$vectors$r
envfit_vectors$p_value <- envfit_result$vectors$pvals
envfit_vectors$q_value <- p.adjust(envfit_vectors$p_value, method = "BH")

envfit_vectors <- envfit_vectors %>%
  arrange(p_value)

write.csv(
  envfit_vectors,
  file.path(out_dir, "envfit_fungal_genera_vectors.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 7. Plot PCoA with top envfit vectors
# ============================================================

top_vectors <- envfit_vectors %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_labels)

arrow_multiplier <- 0.8 * min(
  diff(range(pcoa_matched$Axis1)) / diff(range(top_vectors$Axis1)),
  diff(range(pcoa_matched$Axis2)) / diff(range(top_vectors$Axis2))
)

top_vectors <- top_vectors %>%
  mutate(
    Axis1_plot = Axis1 * arrow_multiplier,
    Axis2_plot = Axis2 * arrow_multiplier
  )

p <- ggplot(pcoa_matched, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = birth_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = outcome_colours, na.value = "grey70") +
  geom_segment(
    data = top_vectors,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      xend = Axis1_plot,
      yend = Axis2_plot
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_vectors,
    aes(
      x = Axis1_plot,
      y = Axis2_plot,
      label = genus
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    colour = "black",
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "RefSeq fungal PCoA with genus drivers",
    x = "PCoA Axis 1",
    y = "PCoA Axis 2",
    colour = "Delivery group"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "refseq_fungal_pcoa_with_genus_vectors.png"),
  p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# ============================================================
# 8. Save simplified interpretation table
# ============================================================

driver_summary <- envfit_vectors %>%
  select(genus, Axis1, Axis2, r2, p_value, q_value) %>%
  mutate(
    main_direction = case_when(
      abs(Axis1) >= abs(Axis2) & Axis1 > 0 ~ "Positive Axis1",
      abs(Axis1) >= abs(Axis2) & Axis1 < 0 ~ "Negative Axis1",
      abs(Axis2) > abs(Axis1) & Axis2 > 0 ~ "Positive Axis2",
      abs(Axis2) > abs(Axis1) & Axis2 < 0 ~ "Negative Axis2",
      TRUE ~ "No clear direction"
    )
  )

write.csv(
  driver_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "fungal_pcoa_driver_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("PCoA driver analysis complete.")
message("Results saved to: ", out_dir)
message("Figure saved to: ", fig_dir)
```
